description.html: The Atman AT-300 is a compact submersible water pump, labeled Water Pump on the box. It runs fully submerged, and suction-cup feet on the housing hold it firmly on the bottom or glass of the aquarium. Ask us about the flow rate and head height before buying, so we can check that the model suits your aquarium or fountain.
The AT-300 is used in nano and small aquariums, tabletop fountains and to move water in terrariums with a waterfall or a small water section. It is also a good choice to power a small DIY filter.

The flow rate stated for pumps is measured with no resistance. Tubing, elbows and the height the pump lifts water to all reduce the real flow, so it is better to choose a model with some reserve. For circulation in an aquarium, the pump should move several times the tank volume per hour; if you are not sure which model suits you, ask us before buying.

Never run the pump dry, as this quickly damages it. From time to time, take it out, remove the front grille and rinse the intake and impeller of sludge and algae. A clean pump runs more quietly and keeps its full flow.
